name: Solid Angle Early Termination for Ambient Occlusion
definition: Stopping ray traversal when a node subtends a certain solid angle, effectively using a lower level-of-detail representation for distant points.
summary: Solid Angle Early Termination for Ambient Occlusion accelerates sparse voxel traversal by culling nodes subtending a small solid angle, differing from other methods by using geometric projection thresholds rather than sampling.
